what: request_main: a go-between's yes conditioned on asking the target first is an accept, not a pass-on.
why: Lika's case 01 (12 Nov), B01. The go-between wrote „yes, I can introduce, ask her first whether she wants to talk“. The model's logged reasoning read it as a pass-on under the rule above and would not accept; it called relay_ask (refused), the request stayed open, and the next line was then forced to a refusal (server half fixed in ac5ec8b5).
approved_by: Misho, 12 Nov 2026, in the code session's chat: „რაც კოდით არ სწორდება იმას პრომპტით უნდა გამოსწორება? თუ პრომპტში არის გამოსასწორებელი ეგეც გამოასწორე“.
